name: Magmalodon
ability: Rough Skin / Flash Fire / Tough Claws (hidden)
look: a large, beefy land shark with a huge fanged mouth glowing inside, smoke hanging from its head like dreads, orange fins, red armour and flames wrapped round its arms and legs
entry: Its body burns hotter than a smelter, and the smoke pouring off its head hangs down its back like dreadlocks. A single bite from its huge jaws can tear through a steel girder.
